source_facts.claim: The mapped documentation specifies shape-export coordinates in pixel units at the top-left origin of the full-resolution image. In the inspected object-export path, QP delegates to PathIO; PathObject serialization uses the ROI adapter, which serializes ROI geometry x/y with a default two-decimal setting. No image calibration or display downsample conversion is visible in this serialization route.
source_facts.limits: Static route inspection only. ROI.getGeometry implementation, complete UI transformations, physical coordinate conversion, other export formats and pixel-center offsets are not established. No candidate seed claim or correction is available for comparison.

source_facts.claim: FEATURE_COLLECTION selects a FeatureCollection wrapper. Without that option, one object serializes singly and other cardinalities serialize as a PathObject list; EXCLUDE_MEASUREMENTS uses a transformation before serialization. PRETTY_JSON selects pretty JSON. The options shown do not themselves specify calibrated coordinates.
source_facts.limits: Does not prove every metadata field is portable or that an arbitrary consumer honors QuPath foreign members; transformation helper behavior was not independently executed.

source_facts.claim: The ROI adapter writes a plane foreign member for a nondefault ImagePlane; its serializer contains c,z,t. The ROI-reader path uses this member when present. A different bare-geometry-to-annotation import branch in GsonTools uses the default plane and marks plane-property handling as TODO.
source_facts.limits: PathObject/ROI and bare-geometry branches must remain distinguished. These sources do not support a blanket claim that all exports erase plane metadata or that all external readers preserve it. Runtime round-trip behavior is UNEXECUTED.

source_facts.claim: The mapped documentation states that GeoJSON turns ellipses into polygons. The ROI adapter additionally writes isEllipse=true for EllipseROI and uses the geometry envelope to reconstruct an ellipse when reading that flag.
source_facts.limits: QuPath-specific reconstruction is not a universal geometry-consumer guarantee. This does not establish exact losslessness, a regression witness, or preserved candidate findings.
